bodyMarkdown:
## Dentist salary Sydney: what you need to know

If you are looking up **dentist salary Sydney**, you will find a wide range of figures depending on whether you check a recruiter survey, the Australian Bureau of Statistics, or the legal minimum. This article explains the key differences and shows you how to convert an hourly rate into annual, fortnightly, and weekly pay using a standard 38-hour week.

### The legal minimum for dentists

According to the Fair Work Ombudsman, no award covers dentists working in private dental practices. This means they are award/agreement free and entitled only to the national minimum wage and the National Employment Standards. From 1 July 2026, the national minimum wage is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 per week for 38 ordinary hours. This is the absolute floor – no employer can pay less than this.

For casual dentists, a 25% casual loading applies on top, bringing the rate to $33.05 per hour. The loading is paid instead of entitlements like paid leave. If you are a casual dentist in Sydney, your minimum is $33.05 per hour.

### Typical earnings and the ABS data

In practice, most dentists earn well above the national minimum wage. The Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) Average Weekly Earnings for May 2026 show full-time adult ordinary time earnings of $2,083.70 per week. For a 38-hour week, that works out to about $54.83 per hour. This figure includes all full-time professionals, not just dentists, but it gives a realistic benchmark for a professional role in Sydney.

Recruiter surveys often report higher figures, but the ABS data is the most reliable public source for average earnings. If you are negotiating a **dentist salary Sydney** offer, use the ABS figure as a reference point, but remember that experience, location, and practice type all affect the actual rate.

### How to convert hourly to annual

To convert an hourly rate to annual pay, use the formula:

**Annual gross pay = hourly rate × hours per week × 52**

We assume 38 hours per week unless stated otherwise. This is the standard full-time week used by the Fair Work Commission.

Examples:
- At the national minimum wage ($26.44/hour): $26.44 × 38 × 52 = $52,261.44 per year.
- At the ABS average ($54.83/hour): $54.83 × 38 × 52 = $108,344.08 per year.

Fortnightly pay is simply weekly pay multiplied by 2. For $26.44/hour, weekly pay is $1,004.90, so fortnightly pay is $2,009.80.

You can use our [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) tool to do this calculation instantly.

### Tax and super considerations

Once you have your annual gross figure, you need to consider tax and super.

**Superannuation** is paid on top of your salary at 12% of ordinary earnings (from 1 July 2026). It is not deducted from your pay. For a dentist earning $108,344 per year, super would be an additional $13,001.28, up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830.

**Income tax** for 2026–27 uses the resident tax-free threshold:
- $0–$18,200: nil
- $18,201–$45,000: 15%
- $45,001–$135,000: 30%
- $135,001–$190,000: 37%
- Above $190,000: 45%

Plus the Medicare levy of 2% (based on 2025–26 single reduction thresholds).

For a dentist on $108,344 per year, the estimated tax (including Medicare) would be about $25,000–$27,000, leaving a take-home pay of around $81,000–$83,000 per year. Use our [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) page for a more precise estimate.

### Casual loading and award-free work

Because dentists are award-free, they do not have access to award penalty rates, allowances, or overtime provisions. If you work as a casual dentist, you are entitled to the 25% casual loading on the national minimum wage. That loading is meant to compensate for not receiving paid leave.

If you are employed on a salary, your employer must still ensure your hourly rate is at least the national minimum wage when divided by your agreed hours. Always check your contract against the [minimum wage](/topics/minimum-wage) and [casual loading](/topics/casual-loading) rules.

### Putting it together for a dentist salary Sydney

When researching **dentist salary Sydney**, remember:
- The legal minimum is $26.44/hour ($33.05 casual).
- The ABS average for full-time professionals is about $54.83/hour.
- Use the formula hourly × 38 × 52 to get annual gross.
- Super is 12% on top, tax depends on your total income.
- No award applies, so negotiate your own conditions.

For a quick estimate, use our [the timesheet](/) tool. Enter your base hourly rate, tick the casual loading box if applicable, and see your weekly, fortnightly, and annual figures with tax and super.

### Disclaimer

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.
